from pathlib import Path
p = Path('lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart')
text = p.read_text()
# Step 1: Insert cassette variant row into LOOK group after screen row
anchor = "        _Cycle('void-settings-screen', 'screen', labelFor(cfg.type), cycleScreen),\n"
insert = (
"        if (cfg is CassetteScreenConfig) ...[\n"
"          _Cycle(\n"
"            'void-settings-cassette-variant',\n"
"            'variant',\n"
"            cassetteVariantMeta[cfg.variant]!.label,\n"
"            () {\n"
"              final next = CassetteVariant.values[(cfg.variant.index + 1) % CassetteVariant.values.length];\n"
"              settings.saveScreenConfig(cfg.copyWith(variant: next));\n"
"            },\n"
"          ),\n"
"        ],\n"
)
if anchor in text:
    text2 = text.replace(anchor, anchor + insert)
    p.write_text(text2)
    print('Step1 applied')
else:
    print('Anchor not found for Step1')
    # For debugging print a snippet
    import sys
    i = text.find(anchor)
    print('Anchor index', i)
    print(text[i-100:i+100])
